## Overview

Fixes [#61425](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/61425) by omitting unset `annotations` and `usage.prompt_tokens_details` from Chat Completions responses and typing annotations as an optional list.

## Claims

- Strict OpenAI schema validators no longer receive `null` for these optional fields.
- Explicit annotation lists and prompt token details remain serialized.

## Validation

- `pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/test_tool_choice_content_none.py -q` — passed (run by the contributor).
- `uv run --no-sync --python 3.13 python -m compileall -q vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/protocol.py vllm/entrypoints/serve/engine/protocol.py tests/entrypoints/openai/test_tool_choice_content_none.py` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

## Details

`ChatMessage` serialized its unset `annotations` value as `null`, and `UsageInfo` did the same for unset prompt token details. The annotation field also used the SDK's single-annotation type despite the OpenAI schema defining an array. The serializers now omit those fields only when unset; supplied values are preserved. No open PR addressing this issue was found when checked. AI assistance was used to investigate and implement the change.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

_Posted by Claude (AI assistant) on behalf of @sethforprivacy, as part of our local-inference tuning work._

Reporter of #61425 here. Thanks @susu-Sugar. This is the fix the issue proposed: `annotations` typed as a list, and both fields omitted only when `None`, with supplied values kept. So I won't open a separate PR.

One note for review: because the omission lives in the serializers, it also covers streaming. The final usage chunk assigns `prompt_tokens_details` (`chat_completion/serving.py:853`), which marks it set, so `exclude_unset` keeps it as `null`, and the new `UsageInfo._serialize` drops it there too.

I've read the diff against the issue but haven't run it.

Thanks for the fix! One suggestion on how the keys are dropped.

vLLM already has a pattern for "omit this field when it is None": `exclude_if` on the field itself, e.g. `ResponsesResponse.metrics`:

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/de7d70676d9a39353aab4796a6987d345c597991/vllm/entrypoints/openai/responses/protocol.py#L821-L824

Using the same here would keep the wire rule next to the field it applies to, and avoid adding a new wrap `model_serializer` (plus the import) to `UsageInfo` just to pop one key:

```python
# vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/protocol.py
annotations: list[OpenAIAnnotation] | None = Field(
    default=None, exclude_if=lambda value: value is None
)
```

```python
# vllm/entrypoints/serve/engine/protocol.py
prompt_tokens_details: PromptTokenUsageInfo | None = Field(
    default=None, exclude_if=lambda value: value is None
)
```

With that, the extra `pop` in `ChatMessage._serialize` and the new `UsageInfo._serialize` are no longer needed. I checked that the validation/serialization JSON schemas and the `model_dump` / `model_dump_json` output (including `exclude_unset`, `include`, and an empty `annotations` list) are identical between the two approaches. `CohereChatMessage` also picks it up through the inherited field.

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

 from vllm.entrypoints.openai.responses.protocol import ResponsesRequest

+from vllm.entrypoints.serve.engine.protocol import PromptTokenUsageInfo, UsageInfo
 from vllm.parser.abstract_parser import DelegatingParser
 
 pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
@@ -123,11 +123,28 @@ def test_chat_completion_response_omits_empty_tool_calls_payload():
     payload_exclude_unset = response.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
 
     assert "tool_calls" not in payload["choices"][0]["message"]
+    assert "annotations" not in payload["choices"][0]["message"]
+    assert "prompt_tokens_details" not in payload["usage"]
     assert "tool_calls" not in payload_exclude_unset["choices"][0]["message"]
     parsed = OpenAIChatCompletion.model_validate(payload)
     assert parsed.choices[0].message.tool_calls is None
 
 
+def test_chat_completion_response_keeps_annotation_and_prompt_token_details():
+    response = _chat_response(ChatMessage(role="assistant", content="done"))
+    response.choices[0].message.annotations = []
+    response.usage.prompt_tokens_details = PromptTokenUsageInfo(cached_tokens=0)
+
+    payload = response.model_dump()
+
+    assert payload["choices"][0]["message"]["annotations"] == []
+    assert payload["usage"]["prompt_tokens_details"] == {
+        "cached_tokens": 0,
+        "created_cache_tokens": None,
+        "multimodal_tokens": None,
+    }
+
+
 def test_chat_completion_response_keeps_non_empty_tool_calls_payload():
     response = _chat_response(
         ChatMessage(

@@ -68,7 +68,7 @@ class ChatMessage(OpenAIBaseModel):
     role: str
     content: str | None = None
     refusal: str | None = None
-    annotations: OpenAIAnnotation | None = None
+    annotations: list[OpenAIAnnotation] | None = None
     audio: OpenAIChatCompletionAudio | None = None
     function_call: FunctionCall | None = None
     tool_calls: list[ToolCall] = Field(default_factory=list)
@@ -81,6 +81,8 @@ def _serialize(self, handler):
         data = handler(self)
         if len(data.get("tool_calls", [])) == 0:
             data.pop("tool_calls", None)
+        if data.get("annotations") is None:
+            data.pop("annotations", None)
         return data

@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
     BaseModel,
     ConfigDict,
     Field,
+    model_serializer,
     model_validator,
 )
 
@@ -138,3 +139,10 @@ class UsageInfo(OpenAIBaseModel):
     completion_tokens: int | None = 0
     prompt_tokens_details: PromptTokenUsageInfo | None = None
     completion_tokens_details: CompletionTokenUsageInfo | None = None
+
+    @model_serializer(mode="wrap")
+    def _serialize(self, handler):
+        data = handler(self)
+        if data.get("prompt_tokens_details") is None:
+            data.pop("prompt_tokens_details", None)
+        return data
